title: CoAnchor: Robust Collaborative Perception under Spatio-Temporal Misalignment via Object-Level Anchors
abstract: arXiv:2608.21055v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Collaborative perception extends the sensing range of a single vehicle by fusing observations from nearby agents, which improves the robustness of autonomous driving. In realistic deployments, however, the received collaborator messages are often affected by both communication delay and relative-pose noise, which jointly cause stale observations, spatial misalignment, and unstable feature fusion. Existing methods usually address these issues from either the spatial or temporal side, but handling them jointly in a unified and efficient manner remains challenging. In this paper, we propose CoAnchor, an anchor-centric spatio-temporal alignment framework for asynchronous collaborative perception. Instead of directly reasoning on dense BEV features, CoAnchor builds sparse object-level spatio-temporal anchors as a shared interface for pose correction and tightly connects spatial refinement, temporal propagation, and current-time verification

translated_title: CoAnchor：通过对象级锚点实现时空错位下的鲁棒协同感知
translated_abstract: 协同感知通过融合附近智能体的观测来扩展单个车辆的感知范围，从而提高自动驾驶的鲁棒性。然而，在实际部署中，接收到的协作消息常常受到通信延迟和相对位姿噪声的影响，这共同导致过时观测、空间错位和不稳定的特征融合。现有方法通常从空间或时间侧单独处理这些问题，但以一种统一且高效的方式联合处理它们仍然具有挑战性。在本文中，我们提出了CoAnchor，一种用于异步协同感知的锚点中心时空对齐框架。CoAnchor不直接在密集的BEV特征上进行推理，而是构建稀疏的对象级时空锚点作为姿态校正的共享接口，并紧密连接空间细化、时间传播和当前时间验证。
tldr: 本文提出CoAnchor，通过对象级锚点作为共享接口，统一高效地联合处理协同感知中的时空错位问题（包括通信延迟和位姿噪声），从而提升异步协作的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CoAnchor, which uses object-level anchors as a shared interface to jointly and efficiently address spatio-temporal misalignment (including communication delay and pose noise) in collaborative perception, enhancing robustness in asynchronous settings.
